dct_title_s: Carte de l'Isle Madagascar dite autrement Madecaſe et de S. Laurens et aujordhui L'Isle Dauphine auecque les costes de Cofala et du Mozambique en Afrique
dct_description_sm: Illustrates "sea routes from the west coast of Africa to Mozambique and from Fort Dauphin on the southeast coast of Madagascar to the north, south, and to the east, to India, Surate and Malacca."

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0335, p. 384
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0335.
